rationale: traceDetails.spec.js already covers Workflow 1 (header View Logs button → /logs) at lines 146-212. The gap is Workflow 2 (span sidebar View Logs button → /logs), which is a distinct path through TraceDetailsSidebar. Appending a new test() to the existing spec reuses the same beforeEach setup (navigate, select stream, select time range, run search, click trace result) and the same page object (tracesPage.js), avoiding duplication.
